typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{Member ID} as string,
		{Last Name} as string,
		Region as string,
		{Account ID} as string,
		{Address Type Indicator} as string,
		{Street Address 1} as string,
		{Street Address 2} as string,
		City as string,
		State as string,
		Zip as string,
		{Bad Address Indicator} as string,
		{Change of Address Indicator} as string,
		{Zip Code + 4} as string,
		FILE_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/KPWA_MemberAddress*']) ~> source1
source1 derive(ADFId__c = uuid()) ~> DerivedColumn1
DerivedColumn1 split(isNull({Member ID})||isNull({Account ID})||isNull({Address Type Indicator})||isNull({Street Address 1})||isNull(City)||isNull(State)||isNull(Zip)||isNull({Last Name})||not(in(['HOME', 'MAILING'], upper({Address Type Indicator}))),
	disjoint: false) ~> ConditionalSplit1@(RejectCondition, toSFDC)
FilterHomeAddress derive(OtherStreet = concat({Street Address 1}, iif(isNull({Street Address 2}), '', concat('\n ', {Street Address 2}))),
		OtherPostalCode = concat(Zip, iif(isNull({Zip Code + 4}), '', concat('-', {Zip Code + 4})))) ~> DerivedColumn2
DerivedColumn2 select(mapColumn(
		Medical_Record_Number__c = {Member ID},
		LastName = {Last Name},
		Region__c = Region,
		Family_Account_Id__c = {Account ID},
		OtherStreet,
		OtherCity = City,
		OtherState = State,
		OtherPostalCode,
		ADFId__c
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
ConditionalSplit1@RejectCondition derive(REJECT_REASON = concat(iif(isNull({Member ID})||isNull({Account ID})||isNull({Address Type Indicator})||isNull({Street Address 1})||isNull(City)||isNull(State)||isNull(Zip)||isNull({Last Name}), concat('ADF:Required Field Missing: ', iif(isNull({Member ID}), '{Member ID} ', ''), iif(isNull({Account ID}), '{Account ID} ', ''), iif(isNull({Address Type Indicator}), '{Address Type Indicator} ', ''), iif(isNull({Street Address 1}), '{Street Address 1} ', ''), iif(isNull({City}), 'City ', ''), iif(isNull({State}), 'State ', ''), iif(isNull({Zip}), 'Zip ', ''), iif(isNull({Last Name}), '{Last Name}', '')), ''),
       iif(not(in(['HOME', 'MAILING'], upper({Address Type Indicator}))), concat('ADF:INVALID VALUE FOR "{Address Type Indicator}": Expected value as "HOME" or "MAILING". Received value as "', {Address Type Indicator}, '".'), ''))) ~> RejectReason
RejectReason select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		REJECT_REASON
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select2
ConditionalSplit1@toSFDC filter(upper({Address Type Indicator}) == 'HOME') ~> FilterHomeAddress
ConditionalSplit1@toSFDC filter(upper({Address Type Indicator}) == 'MAILING') ~> FilterMailingAddress
FilterMailingAddress derive(MailingStreet = concat({Street Address 1}, iif(isNull({Street Address 2}), '', concat('\n ', {Street Address 2}))),
		MailingPostalCode = concat(Zip, iif(isNull({Zip Code + 4}), '', concat('-', {Zip Code + 4})))) ~> DerivedColumn3
DerivedColumn3 select(mapColumn(
		Medical_Record_Number__c = {Member ID},
		LastName = {Last Name},
		Region__c = Region,
		Family_Account_Id__c = {Account ID},
		MailingStreet,
		MailingCity = City,
		MailingState = State,
		MailingPostalCode,
		ADFId__c
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select3
Select1, Select3 union(byName: true)~> Union1
Union1 select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		Medical_Record_Number__c,
		LastName,
		Region__c,
		Family_Account_Id__c,
		OtherStreet,
		OtherCity,
		OtherStateCode = OtherState,
		OtherPostalCode,
		MailingStreet,
		MailingCity,
		MailingStateCode = MailingState,
		MailingPostalCode
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select4
DerivedColumn1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[('KPWA_MemberAddress_raw.csv')],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> IntermediateOutput
Select4 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[('KPWA_MemberAddress_Contact.csv')],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> MemberAddressOutput
Select2 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[('KPWA_MemberAddress_source_reject.csv')],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> RejectOutput
